pre_result_erratum.error: v218.0 incorrectly paired the 13 v207 supplied-calibration initializer fields with the 13 later v209 virtual-ring rigs merely because their array counts matched. The geometries are different and the fields are not index-compatible.
pre_result_erratum.failure_stage: Detected while binding input identities, before any v218 prediction, warm replay, metric, threshold, or decision was generated.
pre_result_erratum.permitted_repair: Retain the v207 potential-normal algorithm, affine center/basis, tau, and cost identity, but regenerate one initializer for each v209 virtual rig from its own sealed observation and reported geometry before truth scoring.

scope: Post-open mechanism gate on the already opened BLASTNet Case 5 virtual-nine roster. It is not fresh validation, training, wall/RSS evidence, curved-ray validation, or real BOST.
scientific_question: Can a camera-permutation-equivariant full-affine potential-normal initializer, computed only from the current virtual-nine observation and reported geometry, reduce the adequate globally fixed geometry-Jacobi PCGLS reference from K16 to at most warm K14 while preserving every absolute and K16-matched four-metric gate over all 546 cells and 13 complete rigs, and can equal-or-cheaper deterministic controls explain any headroom?

allowed_inputs: fixed PoolFire-fit affine center and 1009-dimensional non-DC affine basis
forbidden_inputs: Case 5 raw density or truth field
pass masks, thresholds, or fallback selection
prediction_barrier.process_rule: A prediction-only process must produce all 546 potential-normal initializer fields, diagnostics, source/input seals, and PREDICTION_BARRIER.json before any v218.1 scoring process may read raw density or truth metrics.

virtual_potential_normal_contract.vector_operator: The exact v209 reported finite-source convergent straight-ray voxel-gradient operator for each nine-camera rig.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.scalar_operator: Use the same stored trilinear sample indices, sample weights, ray scales, valid mask, 16x16 detector grid, and camera-major ray order as the vector operator, but omit the voxel-gradient and detector-component projection. Collapse duplicate voxel contributions per ray in float64.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.detector_potential: For each camera, solve the same constrained zero-mean detector-gradient least-squares system used by v184-v207.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.affine_measurement: Project the fixed affine center and all 1009 affine basis rows through the exact reported vector operator, then apply the identical detector-potential map.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.normal_system: M is the camera-resolved potential response. G=M^T M, lambda=(2^-8)^2*lambda_max(G), and coordinates solve (G+lambda I)a=pM.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.independent_solve: separately assembled float64 symmetric eigensystem; it may not import the formal v218.1 prediction module
virtual_potential_normal_contract.camera_permutation: Reversing labeled camera blocks and rebuilding the same geometry in reversed camera order must preserve coordinates and fields within 1e-9 relative error after stable camera-ID restoration.
virtual_potential_normal_contract.compact_online_equivalence: The dense M is permitted only in offline geometry-cache construction and independent audit. The deployment-equivalent streamed packed-normal rhs uses one exact A^T and no A; this inherited logical identity must be disclosed separately from setup probes.

opened_scope.dataset: BLASTNet vitiated H2-air freely propagating flame DNS Case 5

warm_replay.solver: Unmodified strict_pcgls_v10_1 recurrence, denominator floor 1e-30, exact geometry-only Jacobi preconditioner with relative floor 1e-6 and median-positive normalization.
warm_replay.primary_cost_rule: Potential-normal warm depth K uses (K+1)A+(K+1)A^T including one compact initializer A^T and the uncached initial projection.
warm_replay.selection: Select the first single global primary depth passing every absolute and matched gate; per-cell, per-frame, per-rig, metric-dependent, or outcome-dependent selection is forbidden.
warm_replay.reference: Sealed v217.1 geometry-Jacobi PCGLS K16 at 16A+16A^T, 546/546 cells and 13/13 rigs.
warm_replay.strict_reduction: Only K14 or shallower can strictly reduce both exact A and A^T versus K16.

controls.low64_geometry_jacobi_pcgls: Sealed v214 virtual-ring-nine low64 observation proxy, warm K1-K14; cost (K+1)A+K A^T.
controls.normalized_bp_geometry_jacobi_pcgls: Observable normalized A^T y with cached projection, warm K1-K14; cost (K+1)A+(K+1)A^T.
controls.sealed_zero_geometry_jacobi_pcgls: Use v217.1 K8-K16 summaries; K15 has equal 15A+15A^T cost to primary K14 and is known not to match K16.
controls.dense_full_affine_equivalence: The same potential-normal field can be computed from retained dense M at one fewer A^T but much larger retained state. It is an implementation-equivalence disclosure, not a non-equivalent blocking control.
controls.historical_dual_ridge: Inapplicable because no independently sealed compatible predictor exists for v209 virtual rigs; adapting one after Case 5 opening is forbidden.
controls.dominance: Any non-equivalent control that passes all gates with componentwise equal-or-lower exact calls blocks a potential-specific advantage claim.

decision_order: Any prediction-barrier, source, input, scalar/vector roster, finite, gauge, normal-system, factorization, permutation, solver, call-ledger, reference, formal-independent, seal, or decision mismatch gives INCONCLUSIVE_INVALID_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_V218_1.
If no primary K1-K14 checkpoint passes every absolute and K16-matched gate, conclude FAIL_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_INSUFFICIENT_V218_1 and close this mechanism.
If the primary passes but an equal-or-cheaper non-equivalent control also passes, conclude PASS_DETERMINISTIC_WARM_HEADROOM_BUT_CONTROL_EXPLAINS_POTENTIAL_V218_1.
Only if the primary passes by K14, strictly reduces both exact calls, and no control dominates it may conclude PASS_CASE5_POTENTIAL_NORMAL_PCGLS_WARM_HEADROOM_V218_1.

Any positive result is post-open deterministic mechanism headroom only and cannot establish learning, fresh generalization, wall/RSS speedup, curved rays, real BOST, paper success, or algorithm breakthrough.
failure_action: Do not tune tau, affine rank, scalar map, warm depth per cell, thresholds, cache form, or regularization, and do not rescue a failure with CNN/FNO/UNO/DeepONet or GPU training.
